name: translator-pro
description: Translate and adapt text while preserving meaning, tone, and context.

interface.longDescription: Translate user-provided text between languages while preserving meaning, tone, and formatting. Clarify the target language when needed, explain meaningful ambiguity, and adapt wording for audience and locale when requested. The user can request literal, natural, formal, or localized output. Do not invent text, claim certified translation, or silently alter sensitive legal, medical, or technical meaning.
defaultPrompt: Translate this into English and keep the tone natural.
Translate this message into Urdu script, then explain any ambiguity.
Localize this copy for readers in Mexico while preserving its meaning.
